info.description:
This course provide the basics of how data is sent and received in a network and how small computer networks are created, introduce a variety of concepts, practice activities and simulations that help build the learner’s skills and understanding of computer networking. You will learn how to set up a basic home network, configure devices for connectivity, understand how communication takes place on a network, and what minimal best practices should be implemented to secure the network. Learners will also be introduced to Cisco IOS® software used to manage Cisco routers and switches.

Assessment scheme:

1. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam

2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100%

3. Student gets 0.25 bonus points for each course completed on time. The total bonus point is not greater than 1.

4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) >= 5

5. In the case: (5 > Final TE Score >=4) & (5 > Final PE Score >=4) & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) < 5, the student can choose to take the resit of both TE & PE OR just either TE or PE.

clos.loDetails: Explain basic terminology related to computer networks
Describe the features and functions of various devices installed in a typical simple computer networks
Describe the network services and applications for file transfer, web access, email, remote access and instant messaging
Use various tools to verify network operations
Implement basic networks (simple peer-to-peer network, home network, LAN network...)
Explain the functions of typical devices, softwares, tools … regarding the construction and operation of Cisco network
